name: Reconstructed Tome
summary: In warlocks’ hands, the Reconstructed Tome gathers the scattered teachings of the cabal. Its pages hold the rites for summoning and binding a felhunter from the Twisting Nether.

sections.title: A Grimoire Reassembled
sections.body: Warlocks of the Alliance and Horde search for the torn leaves of the Tome of the Cabal. They piece the grimoire back together and consult occult scholars, who are eager to glimpse its rare teachings before the finished book is surrendered.

sections.title: Key to the Felhunter
sections.body: Strahad Farsan, a summoning master near Ratchet’s port in the Barrens, receives the restored tome and rods of channeling taken from Dragonmaw spellcasters. Its rituals give his acolytes the incantations to help a warlock summon a ravenous felhunter, overcome it, and bind it to their will.

faq.q: What is the Reconstructed Tome used for?
faq.answer: The Reconstructed Tome holds cabal teachings and rituals for summoning and binding a felhunter. A warlock brings it with rods of channeling to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet for the ritual.
Strahad Farsan is an expert summoner who dwells above Ratchet’s port in the Barrens. He oversees trials for warlocks seeking to enslave more dangerous demons.

faq.q: Why do the scholars examining the book want a copy?
faq.answer: The scholars helping decipher the torn pages find the cabal’s occult texts rare and fascinating. Dwarven and Forsaken researchers covet the demonic knowledge, which surpasses their usual reading.

faq.q: What else is needed alongside the tome for the ritual?
faq.answer: Strahad requires three rods of channeling so his acolytes can sustain the summoning ritual. Dragonmaw spellcasters in the Wetlands hold the rods.

angles.text: As a warlock, assembling the Reconstructed Tome opens the dark rites for dominating a felhunter. Its hunger for magic can be turned against opposing spellcasters.
